method: All 365 frozen Daily opening boards; replay the previous board-seeded neutral selector exactly and compare to current recommendations. Split opportunities only: no mysteryId, secret answer, future puzzle path or actual-elimination claims are used or recorded.

afterOneManualQuestion.method: For each board use over:120 when available, otherwise lexicographically first valid question, then evaluate BOTH possible earned answer branches. Compare first still-usable old original with first recomputed recommendation; no hidden answer is consulted.

limitation: These are metadata-based Yes/No splits among current candidates, not guaranteed elimination percentages, win rates or a claim of globally optimal play.
